title: Deciding finite-lattice embeddability into c.e. degrees

import_provenance.original_statement: Is there an algorithm deciding which finite lattices embed into the computably enumerable Turing degrees while preserving joins and meets? A structural characterization would explain which finite patterns of relative computability can occur.
